marginVsTotal.meaning: positive means heavier favourites coincide with higher scoring, which matters for a spread-plus-over parlay

weekToWeekMarginAutocorrelation.meaning: how much of last week's margin carries into this week — it sets the decay a rating must apply

slateClustering.meaning: a ratio above 1 means home teams win together on the same day more often than independence predicts, which is what makes a same-day multi-leg parlay riskier than the multiplied price implies

parlay.note: Both legs come from the model's own numbers. A real parlay must be priced against the exact offered line and price for each leg, which this repository does not hold.

propCombos.reason: No player-level season statistics and no player-prop prices are captured by tools/fetch_nfl_lab.py; nfl.com's player-statistics page renders client-side, and no prop price feed exists in this repository.

estimate pairwise association from settled joint outcomes only, and publish n with it
refuse a combo price when the joint sample does not exist

G1.title: Data provenance
G1.rule: Every input row carries an official source URL and a capture timestamp.
G1.evidence: every forecast row carries the nfl.com game URL; the fetcher writes retrievedUTC per dataset

G2.title: Coverage and integrity
G2.rule: Games with results, availability rows with a club, and null handling are counted; no silent imputation.
G2.evidence: 132 games with official scores; 437 availability rows across 31 clubs; nulls kept as nulls

G3.title: Beats naive baselines
G3.rule: Out-of-sample log loss and Brier must improve on the home-field-only and net-points baselines.
G3.evidence: log loss 0.69788 vs baseline 0.69788 on n=100

G4.title: Leakage audit
G4.rule: Each week is forecast only from earlier weeks; team rates and the margin sigma are re-fitted inside that window.
G4.evidence: week w uses only weeks < w; team rates, sigma and the shrink factor are re-fitted inside that window

G5.title: Out-of-sample performance
G5.rule: At least 60 settled forecasts, with calibration error and uncertainty reported.

G6.title: Robustness
G6.rule: The leader must survive deficit-weight scaling and week-level block resampling.
G6.evidence: rank 2 of 4 strategies under all 3 shrink policies (nested-validation (published), fixed 0.5 (heavy shrink), fixed 1.0 (no shrink)); deficit-weight scaling x0.5/x1.0/x2.0 is published under 'sensitivity'

G7.title: Prospective paper trial
G7.rule: A frozen, timestamped forecast ledger started before outcomes, for a predeclared horizon.
G7.evidence: data/nfl-signals/forward-ledger.json holds 41 frozen predictions: 0 settled, 41 open, 1 voided; the promotion gate needs 60 settled

G8.title: Release review
G8.rule: Reproducible run, independent review, no integrity or responsible-use blocker.
G8.evidence: independent review and responsible-use sign-off have not happened
